explanation: The Almighty Creator who rules over nature and humanity, and who gives Jesus authority to heal and cast out evil spirits.
Christ, the Son of God, who has full power over the devil, diseases, and death in this story about the possessed man and Jairus' daughter.
A person is under the power or control of an evil spirit, causing them to lose their willpower and act against their best interest.
An evil spiritual being that can take over a human body and cause suffering, but must obey Jesus' command to leave.
The state in which a person is restored to full health after suffering from illness or demonic possession through God's power.
A strong belief and trust that Jesus has the power to make the impossible possible, as shown by Jairus and the woman with the bleeding issue.
The child of Jairus who was dead when Jesus arrived, but was raised back to life through Jesus' word and touch.
The gift of existence and health that God gives, and which Jesus restores to the dead and sick in this chapter.
